value.stringValue: Schedule Your Program Director Meeting - Zenith Prep Academy
Schedule Your Onboarding Meeting - Zenith Prep Academy

Flow.description: Books PD SOM (60 min) or Follow-up (30 min) calls. Uses weighted round-robin for first PD assignment, sticky routing for follow-ups.

formulas.name: pdEmailBody
formulas.expression:
"

Hi " & {!Get_Primary_Contact.Contact.FirstName} & ",

Thank you for choosing Zenith Prep Academy! We're excited to connect you with your dedicated Program Director for a strategy planning session.

Please use the link below to select a time that works best for you:

Schedule Your PD Meeting

This meeting will be approximately 60 minutes via Zoom.

Best regards,
Zenith Prep Academy

"

formulas.name: fssEmailBody
formulas.expression:
"

Hi " & {!Get_Primary_Contact.Contact.FirstName} & ",

Welcome to the Zenith Prep Academy family! We're thrilled to have you on board.

Please use the link below to schedule your onboarding meeting:

Schedule Your Onboarding Meeting

This meeting will be approximately 30 minutes via Zoom.

Best regards,
Zenith Prep Academy

"

formulas.name: pdSubject
formulas.expression: IF({!varIsFollowUp}, "Program Director Follow Up - Zenith Prep Academy", "Program Director - 60 Minutes - Zenith Prep Academy")
